gloss: large snowflakes; wet snow falling in clumps

definitions.gloss: large snowflakes; wet snow falling in clumps
definitions.explanation: Large, fluffy snowflakes that cluster together and fall slowly, resembling peony petals. This type of snow typically occurs when the temperature is near freezing.

examples.japanese: {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。

examples.english: Outside the window, large snowflakes were dancing in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦{積|つ}もり→積もる：01964_tsumoru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: In the evening it changed to large wet snowflakes, and before long the snow started piling up.

notes:
Named after the ⟦{牡丹|ぼたん}→牡丹：13488_botan⟧ (peony) flower because the large, clumped snowflakes resemble peony petals. This is a poetic and evocative weather term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (large snowflakes fall)
- {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧ (large snowflakes dance)

USAGE:
{牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき} is wet and heavy compared to ⟦{粉雪|こなゆき}→粉雪：13858_konayuki⟧ (powder snow), which is dry and fine. {牡丹雪|ぼたんゆき} typically falls when temperatures are close to 0°C, so it melts quickly on the ground.
